decision: Austin, 2026-11-01. Round one: on the synth vs Wavelength comparison page he picked the Wavelength take for 66 recipes (roundOnePicks), kept the other 69 synth recipes and asked for burp, sneeze and fireworks to be redone. A take ships only when every sound source its Wavelength job plays may be redistributed as a standalone game sound in a public repo (sources: CC0, public domain, or a permissive licence with its notice kept). Round one used Serum 2, Bitwig and Apple samples for 50 of the 66, so those were re-rendered on MuseScore General and Wavelength's own synth (the clean round); he picked 35 of them, sneeze take a and fireworks take b from the redo round, and approved the 16 round-one takes that were clean already.
author: Austin Ginder

rounds.about: Clean-licence round: round one's notes, timing and levels re-rendered on MuseScore General and Wavelength's builtin:synth (clean.py).
Redo round: three candidates each for burp, sneeze and fireworks (redo.py); burp is still open.
